policy: These are Noon-authored public examples intentionally limited to the Manim-compatible API surface. They are not copied upstream Manim documentation examples, so they remain separate from the exact-source tutorial manifest.

entries.title: AffineFade
entries.summary: Manim-compatible FadeIn/FadeOut using shift, scale, and target_position.
entries.thumbnail_alt: Blue circle illustrating shifted and scaled fade endpoints

entries.title: FamilyTransformIndicate
entries.summary: Manim-compatible VGroup transform with lag_ratio followed by an Indicate pulse.
entries.thumbnail_alt: Pink square and blue circle with an indicate pulse

entries.title: TimedComposition
entries.summary: Nested Succession with timed Add/Wait steps, then LaggedStartMap applies FadeOut to each square.
entries.thumbnail_alt: Three blue squares illustrating nested timed composition

entries.title: FamilyWrite
entries.summary: Write a styled VGroup with lag_ratio so its members reveal in order.
entries.thumbnail_alt: Styled orange square and pink circle being written as a family

entries.title: SubsetDisplay
entries.summary: ShowIncreasingSubsets followed by ShowSubmobjectsOneByOne on ordered VGroups.
entries.thumbnail_alt: Colored circle rows illustrating increasing and one-by-one subset display

entries.title: ScaleInPlace
entries.summary: Scale a geometry object around its own center using the Manim-compatible ScaleInPlace animation.
entries.thumbnail_alt: Blue square shown before and after an in-place scale

entries.title: IndicateSquare
entries.summary: Pulse a geometry object with Manim-compatible Indicate semantics.
entries.thumbnail_alt: Blue square with a surrounding indication pulse

entries.title: SpinInShrinkToCenter
entries.summary: Spin a square in from nothing, then remove it with ShrinkToCenter.
entries.thumbnail_alt: Blue square illustrating spin-in and shrink-to-center lifecycle

entries.title: TextWrite
entries.summary: Move one plain Text object while writing another, then remove it with Unwrite.
entries.thumbnail_alt: MOVE text shifting horizontally while WRITE is revealed above it

entries.title: TextFamilyFade
entries.summary: Lagged FadeIn/FadeOut over a VGroup of plain Text while a disjoint Text is written in parallel.
entries.thumbnail_alt: LEFT and RIGHT text fading in as a family while WRITE appears below

entries.title: TextFamilyReveal
entries.summary: Create and Uncreate a VGroup of unequal plain Text leaves alongside a single Text and a moving Square.
entries.thumbnail_alt: I and LONG text revealing from left to right above a moving square

entries.title: GroupSlicing
entries.summary: Slice a VGroup and mutate the selected shared members without replacing the original family.
entries.thumbnail_alt: Square below a circle and rectangle shifted upward through a VGroup slice

entries.title: ArrowVectorFieldStatic
entries.summary: Static rotational ArrowVectorField with explicit 2D ranges and Manim-compatible default length and norm-color behavior.
entries.thumbnail_alt: Five by three rotational vector field with a zero vector at the center
